errors.error_description: Introduced an overly deep nested if-else chain in a combinational block to compute immediates and flags, creating long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
In a combinational case on opcode, intentionally omitted a default and did not assign 'jump' in all paths, causing an unintended latch inference.
Used an explicit sensitivity list 'always @(opcode or enable)' but read 'mode' inside the block, leading to a sensitivity list mismatch.
Wrote a sequential process as 'always @(clk or rst_n)' without edge qualifiers, mixing level-sensitive behavior with intended flip-flop logic.
